jobs.description:
At   SafetyWing  (YC W18) , we’re building a global social safety net for remote workers—simple health, insurance, and retirement products designed to replace national welfare systems. Our mission is to remove geographical borders as a barrier to equal opportunity and freedom for everyone. If we succeed, we believe this will be one of the most important tasks of our time.  🌎 About this Role   Somewhere in the world right now, a  SafetyWing  member is messaging us. Maybe they're stuck abroad and need help fast, or they're trying to understand what their plan covers. Often the first one to answer is our AI agent, built on Intercom Fin.   We're looking for an AI Support Operations Specialist to fully own the AI agent: to make it sharper, more helpful, more human, and to keep us at the front as AI support keeps changing. You’ll own how the AI Agent performs: what it resolves, how well it resolves it, and when it hands off. You’ll also measure the difference it makes for members.   👩‍💻 What you’ll do:  
  Turn our AI agent into a top performer  
 
 Make sure our AI agent always has the most up to date information about our products, by checking with our internal policy experts 
 Look at where it succeeds, hands off or misses, find the root cause and add it to our roadmap 
 Test changes before and after launch, and keep record of what changed and what it achieved 
 Spot the next opportunities to expand the AI agent into new products and more complex support journeys 
 
  Shape how it behaves  
 
 Write and refine the AI agent's guidance, tone, and handoff behavior so every answer sounds like  SafetyWing : warm, clear, and accurate 
 Build, test, and maintain procedures and Intercom workflows, and partner with Engineering when you need integrations or technical work 
 Make sure members reach a person smoothly whenever the AI agent isn't the right one to help 
 
  Stay ahead of AI support  
 
 Keep track of new Intercom capabilities and the wider AI support field 
 Separate real breakthroughs from hype, run small pilots, and recommend what we should adopt next 
 Share what you learn in a way the team can act on right away 
 
  Work with others  
 
 Turn your findings into clear, prioritized requests for knowledge owners, and coordinate the updates that improve the AI agent's answers 
 Work with Product, Engineering, and Compliance on bugs, data questions, and new capabilities. 
 Report on the AI agent's performance to Customer Care leadership 
 Build a feedback loop so anyone in Customer Care can flag an issue and see how it was resolved 
 
 
 🧪  We are looking for someone who: 
 
 
 Has configured and improved Intercom Fin, including Guidance, workflows, or Procedures, and can show the results 
 Writes responses that are clear, accurate, and human, and can tell when one isn't 
 Finds patterns in the data, gets to the root cause, tests a fix, and measures whether it worked 
 Is comfortable with technical setup and can talk through integrations and configuration confidently with engineers 
 Follows AI closely and tests new tools, but can tell hype from real value 
 Brings teams together with clear evidence and simple explanations, and follows through 
 Extra-shine if you have experience with data privacy, insurance or healthcare 
 
  😀 We like to work with people who:  
 
 Want to help build a global social safety net on the Internet 
 Think for themselves instead of copying others 
 Are willing to try new things, even with the risk of failure 
 Are intellectually curious and open to new ideas 
 Are creative and bold in the face of any problems 
 Have strong integrity and do the right thing 
 
  🧘 Benefits beyond base pay:  
 
 Fully remote work environment – work from anywhere globally 
 Our own global safety net, giving you worldwide health, income, and travel coverage 
 A minimum of four weeks of vacation per year 
 A new laptop 
 Potential to unlock equity compensation, yearly home office allowance and more! 
 
 🚀 We look forward to hearing from you! 
  Originally posted on  Himalayas

What are we building?   Hard Rock Digital  is a  fiercely focused  team working to become the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We're building a  deeply curious  team with a passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We're  customer-obsessed  — we care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight, and strive to ensure we're always acting authentically.  Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida,  Hard Rock Digital  taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We're taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space - ready to join us?  What’s the position?  We are looking for associates to work in our new sportsbook operations team. You will be working on the front line of all tech, process and trading issues that impact sportsbook.   In this position you will:   
  have our customers' experience at the forefront of your mind at all times  
  take control in coordinating, instructing and challenging the necessary teams to mitigate against negative customer experience  
  have full understanding of the life cycle of sportsbook issues – from customer service query to customer fulfillment.   
  become an expert on the compliance regulations,   
  be trained to know all of our service level agreements and key performance indicators inside out. You will brief stakeholders on the impacts of any issues and help the business use the lessons learned to continuously improve how we serve our customers.  
  Requirements  What are we looking for?  We are looking for someone with a passion for sports, and an equal passion for creating unparalleled customer experience, to be a success in this role you will be:   
  be prepared to work overnight flexible hours to mirror the sporting schedule.  
  the person 'who can keep their head when all about you are losing theirs'.   
  a level-headed problem solver who understands that small friction points can have a material impact on overall customer experience.   
  a diligent, detail focused individual who has a capacity to retain, document and utilise complex information.   
  strong, knowledgeable and articulate in a crisis. Ideally you will have had some exposure to sportsbook but if not your passion for sports and or betting will do just fine!  
  What’s in it for you?  We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:  
  Competitive pay and benefits  
  Flexible vacation allowance  
  Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand  
  Roster of Uniques  We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunities employer)  Originally posted on  Himalayas

Job Title:  Domain Researcher, Finance (M&A)   Job Type:  Full-time  Location: Remote     The Role    Join our research team as a  Domain Researcher (DR),  where you'll help advance AI-powered financial reasoning, with a focus on Corporate Development, Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), and strategic transactions.    We're looking for professionals with hands-on experience in corporate development, acquisition evaluation, and M&A execution who can translate real-world financial expertise into rigorous AI evaluation frameworks.    What You'll Be Doing   
  Design and develop evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and scoring methodologies for AI agents operating in corporate development and M&A workflows.  
  Create realistic test cases covering acquisition screening, valuation, financial due diligence, deal structuring, and strategic investment decisions.  
  Evaluate AI-generated financial analyses, valuation models, acquisition assessments, and investment recommendations.  
  Translate real-world M&A experience into structured datasets, research scenarios, and measurable evaluation criteria.  
  Collaborate with AI researchers, engineers, and product teams to identify model limitations and improve financial reasoning capabilities.  
  Conduct applied research and document findings to advance AI performance in corporate finance and acquisition-related tasks.  
   What We're Looking For   
  Strong professional experience in Corporate Development, M&A, Investment Banking, Private Equity, or Strategic Investments, with direct exposure to acquisition-related transactions.  
  Hands-on experience across the M&A lifecycle, including target screening, valuation, due diligence, transaction analysis, or deal execution.  
  Strong understanding of acquisition strategies, financial modeling, company valuation (DCF, comparables, precedent transactions), and strategic fit assessments.  
  Experience preparing or evaluating investment memoranda, acquisition recommendations, and transaction-related financial analyses.  
  Ability to translate complex financial workflows into structured research questions, evaluation frameworks, and measurable criteria.  
  Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams.  
  Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Accounting, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.  
   Preferred Qualifications   
  Direct experience within an in-house Corporate Development team, particularly involving buy-side acquisitions.  
  Experience executing or supporting M&A transactions from target identification through due diligence and closing.  
  Background in technology-sector acquisitions, SaaS businesses, or strategic investments.  
  MBA, CFA, or relevant advanced financial qualifications.  
  Familiarity with AI agents, large language models, AI evaluation methodologies, or financial AI applications.  
  Proficiency with financial modeling and analytical tools such as Excel, Python, or SQL.  
   Compensation & Benefits Notice    The national pay range for this full-time position is base salary of $200,000 –$250,000. All employees are eligible for equity compensation, and employees may also receive performance-based bonuses, dependent on role and subject to company policies.  micro1  provides a comprehensive benefits package, including up to 100% reimbursement for health-insurance premiums, paid time off, a 401(K) plan with a company match, and additional benefits designed to support a high-performing, remote-first workforce.     micro1  is an equal opportunity employer. About  Cority   Cority  helps customers see and prevent risks across their operations in real time. Our EHS+ platform converges people, data, and AI agents to provide a clear view of information people can trust, automate workflows that make people more impactful, and deliver personalized insights and expertise to improve decision-making. While most solutions respond to risks one at a time,  Cority  helps prevent them across environmental management, employee health, safety, quality, and sustainability. For 40 years,  Cority  has been the market leader in EHS+, recognized by top analysts and trusted by more than 1,500 of the most complex organizations worldwide.  Cority  has received many awards for its strong employee culture and outstanding business performance. To learn more, visit www.cority.com.  About the role:  We're looking for a Financial Analyst to join our FP&A team. Reporting to the Manager, FP&A, you'll own forecasting and reporting for partner departments, build key inputs to our monthly board pack, and act as the day-to-day finance partner to department heads. This is a hands-on, driver-based modelling role suited to someone who wants exposure to SaaS/recurring-revenue metrics (ARR, NRR, GRR) and cross-functional finance work. What You'll Do  
 Support the annual budgeting and department forecast processes — gather business-partner inputs, update models, and flag variances above threshold 
 Support Professional Services reporting — track utilization, backlog, and POC revenue, and assist with the PS forecast and capacity plan 
 Prepare board pack components, including variance tables and KPI charts 
 Provide accrual inputs to accounting and support post-close flux analysis 
 Reconcile actuals to forecast each month-end 
 Act as finance partner to a department head, including attending the monthly BVA (budget-vs-actual) analysis meeting 
 Assist with scenario and sensitivity analysis under the Manager's direction 
  What We're Looking For  
 Comfort building and maintaining driver-based financial models 
 Ability to write clear variance commentary, not just build the variance table 
 Strong operating discipline — reporting calendars, version control, and attention to detail 
 SaaS or recurring-revenue background preferred; familiarity with ARR, NRR, GRR, and ARR-to-billings-to-GAAP-revenue bridges is a plus 
 Familiarity with the Professional Services function at a SaaS company is a plus 
 Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field 
 1–3 years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, or a related analytical role 
 Advanced Excel skills; experience with a budgeting/forecasting platform (e.g., Pigment, Drivetrain, Vena) is a plus 
  WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?  
 An opportunity to work in a values-driven, performance oriented, dynamic and growth focused culture 
 We support a remote working environment with a one-time home office allowance and subsidized monthly internet allowance 
 Competitive health benefits, dental plans, and retirement savings plan (RRSP, 401K plan etc.) 
 Annual fitness allowance 
 Mental health support provided through access to Calm Premium meditation app and access to Talkspace 
 Access to learning tools & platforms, internal training programs, annual training allowance and certifications (if applicable), and High Talent Programs 
   Cority  is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.  Cority  is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, nationality, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, age, disability or any other legally protected status. For applicants who would like to request for accommodation please send an email to .  Originally posted on  Himalayas
